svg.title: Throughput: requests per second at each load step
svg.desc: Throughput: requests per second at each load step (every request the server answered): 50 users: 47 requests/s; 100 users: 87 requests/s; 200 users (SLO step): 170 requests/s; 350 users: 286 requests/s; 700 users (last in SLO): 579 requests/s; 1,050 users (knee): 635 requests/s; 1,600 users (spike): 696 requests/s; 200 users (recovery): 165 requests/s

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
